body.message:
Hello,

We would like to let you know in advance that we will be moving out of Elite Business Bay Residence on Sunday. Our moving service with Justlife is scheduled between 10:00 AM and the afternoon.

Unfortunately, the moving company had no other available dates, and since Sunday is our final day and we have already booked and paid for the service, we are unable to reschedule it.

We don’t have many belongings. Our only large item is one wardrobe, so we wanted to inform you in advance.

Thank you for your understanding.
